HomePage.architecture.title: Technical architecture
HomePage.cta.description: Experience the Telos intelligent workflow orchestration platform now and boost your automation efficiency.
HomePage.cta.title: Are you ready to get started?
HomePage.description: It supports automatic task scheduling and management, adopts front-end and back-end separation and microservice architecture, and is designed for enterprise-level automation scenarios.
HomePage.features.backend: The backend uses the Go microservices architecture to ensure high performance and scalability.
HomePage.features.communication: Supports tRPC/gRPC for type-safe and efficient service-to-service communication.
HomePage.features.deployment: The whole process is containerized and has built-in CI/CD support to ensure continuous delivery.
HomePage.features.frontend: The front-end is based on Next.js 15 and Shadcn UI to provide a smooth and consistent user experience.
HomePage.features.monorepo: Unified Monorepo management for easy dependency centralization and team collaboration.
HomePage.features.title: Core features
HomePage.flowSection.addToChannelDesc: Invite users to join the channel
HomePage.flowSection.triggerDesc: At the time of the 'Create User' form submission
HomePage.gsap.animation: Cool admission animations powered by GSAP!
HomePage.landing.capabilities.agentStudi: Create dedicated agents with roles, models, tone, tool permissions, and working boundaries so each agent maps to a real job.
HomePage.landing.capabilities.scopedMemo: Separate long-term memory by user, agent, and workspace, preserving preferences, history, and task state without cross-account leakage.
HomePage.landing.capabilities.teamContro: Use OAuth and organizational identity to control who can create, call, inspect, and audit agents, tools, and runs.
HomePage.landing.capabilities.title: Move from a conversation to an executable agent operating system.
HomePage.landing.capabilities.toolRegist: Connect mail, calendar, Slack, Discord, browser actions, or internal APIs as callable tools so agents can handle real work.
HomePage.landing.capabilities.workflowRu: Chain triggers, conditional branches, multi-step actions, and human approvals into flows that run from request to delivery.
HomePage.landing.cta.description: Create an agent, then attach tools and memory. Telos turns conversations into automation that can keep running, be audited, and scale with your team.
HomePage.landing.cta.title: Connect your first agent to a real workflow.
HomePage.landing.governance.description: User identity determines what an agent can see and which tools it can call. Each run leaves context and records, so the next task can continue instead of starting over.
HomePage.landing.governance.title: Make every agent run authorized, traceable, and reusable.
HomePage.landing.hero.description: Telos brings conversations, tools, workflows, long-term memory, and identity controls into one surface, so agents can do more than answer. They can safely complete real work.
HomePage.landing.hero.subtitle: The workspace to create, connect, run, and govern AI agents for your team.
HomePage.landing.stats.connect.label: Attach tools and channels
HomePage.landing.stats.create.label: Define agent roles
HomePage.landing.stats.govern.label: Access, memory, and audit
HomePage.landing.stats.run.label: Orchestrate workflows
HomePage.quickStart.title: Get started quickly
HomePage.subtitle: A modern, highly scalable platform for intelligent workflow orchestration
HomePage.techStack.backend.gin: Gin/Echo – Efficient and lightweight HTTP framework for rapid API development.
HomePage.techStack.backend.go: Go – Natively high concurrency, excellent performance, suitable for microservice architectures.
HomePage.techStack.backend.grpc: gRPC – A high-performance RPC framework based on Protobuf that optimizes service communication.
HomePage.techStack.backend.postgresql: PostgreSQL – An enterprise-grade relational database that ensures data consistency and security.
HomePage.techStack.backend.redis: Redis – Cache and task queues to improve data access efficiency.
HomePage.techStack.backend.title: Back-end technology stack
HomePage.techStack.frontend.nextjs: Next.js 15 – Implement server-side components and efficient routing with App Router.
HomePage.techStack.frontend.shadcn: Shadcn UI – A library of high-quality components based on Tailwind CSS for agile development.
HomePage.techStack.frontend.title: Front-end technology stack
HomePage.techStack.frontend.trpc: tRPC – Frontend and backend type security API communication scheme.
HomePage.techStack.frontend.typescript: TypeScript – A strongly typed language that improves code robustness and maintainability.
HomePage.techStack.frontend.zustand: Zustand – Lightweight state management for complex interaction logic.
HomePage.techStack.infrastructure.docker: Docker – A containerized deployment solution for environment consistency.
HomePage.techStack.infrastructure.helm: Helm – A standardized deployment and management tool for Kubernetes applications.
HomePage.techStack.infrastructure.kubern: Kubernetes – Automated cluster orchestration and elastic scaling.
HomePage.techStack.infrastructure.monito: Prometheus & Grafana – Complete monitoring and visualization.
HomePage.techStack.infrastructure.title: infrastructure
HomePage.techStack.infrastructure.tracin: Jaeger – Distributed Tracing for Service Performance Analysis.
